svg.title: One query as a fiber: cpu ticks, memory and disk iops charged to it and checked against the tenant's caps
svg.desc: Three runs of the same query from tenant A. In the first, cpu ticks reach the cap of 1,000 per second, the fiber is parked with its work held, and it resumes as soon as budget allows. In the second, disk iops reach the cap of 250 per second and the same happens. In the third, memory reaches the cap of 64 MiB, the allocation fails and an out_of_memory error is returned to the client, freeing the memory.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: ONE QUERY · ONE FIBER · TENANT A

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: SELECT id, sku, day, amount FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
